mentions.title: You Got This E4 ft. Bebe Vio, Ludovica Olgiati & Girls | Nike
mentions.fullMention:
You Got This E4 ft. Bebe Vio, Ludovica Olgiati & Girls | Nike Fencer Bebe Vio and Content Creator Ludovica Olgiati talk about their growing pains and how they overcame them with sport. This episode is a reminder that while, sometimes you may fall, getting back up is always worth it.
